	PROCEDURE Click
		DO CASE
			CASE this.cTipo="ABM"
				oApp.DoForm("Tg_FormAbm",ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir),.t.)                                  
			CASE this.cTipo="LIS"
				oApp.DoForm("Tg_Listados",UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir)))
			CASE this.cTipo="PRO"
				oApp.DoForm(ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir))
			CASE this.cTipo="CON"
				oApp.DoForm(ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir))
			CASE this.cTipo="EJE"
				oApp.Ejecutar(ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir))
			CASE this.cTipo="EXE"
		    	oApp.EjecutarRun(ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir))
			CASE this.cTipo="OTR"
				lbTemp = ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir)
				&lbTemp
		ENDCASE
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LPARAMETERS cForm, cTipo
		
		this.cFormAAbrir = cForm
		this.cTipo = cTipo
		this.WordWrap = .T.
		this.modulo = ""
		
		IF _screen.activeform.oTblMainMenu.buscar(ALLTRIM(UPPER(cForm)), .F., "AUID_PROCE")
			this.modulo = _screen.activeform.oTblMainMenu.leer("id_modulo")
		ENDIF

			IF _screen.activeform.oTblTemas.buscar(_screen.activeform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
				this.BackColor = _screen.activeform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnMenu")

			ELSE
				this.BackColor = RGB(229,20,0)
				this.ForeColor = RGB(255,255,255)
			ENDIF
		ENDIF
		
		this.FontName = "Tahoma"
		this.FontSize = 9
		
		
		*!*	IF thisform.oTblProcesos.buscar(this.cTipo, .F., "CLAVE")
		*!*		this.BackColor = thisform.oTblProcesos.leer("colorFondo")
		*!*		this.ForeColor = thisform.oTblProcesos.leer("colorLetra")
		*!*	ELSE
		*!*		this.BackColor = RGB(229,20,0)

		*!*		CASE this.cTipo="ABM"
		*!*			this.BackColor = RGB(164,196,0)
		*!*		CASE this.cTipo="LIS"
		*!*			this.BackColor = RGB(170,0,255)

		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord

	PROCEDURE RightClick
		LOCAL cForm, cTipo, cTitulo, cModulo
		
		cForm = ALLTRIM(this.cFormAAbrir)
		cTipo = ALLTRIM(this.cTipo)
		cTitulo = ALLTRIM(this.Caption)
		cModulo = ALLTRIM(this.modulo)
		
		DEFINE POPUP menuccp  FROM MROW(),MCOL() ;
			SHORTCUT RELATIVE  MARGIN  COLOR RGB(255,255,255);
		 	FONT 'MS Sans Serif', 8 
		 	
		 	IF !_screen.activeform.esFavorito(cForm,cTipo)
			    DEFINE BAR 1 OF menuccp PROMPT "Agregar Favorito"
			    ON SELECTION BAR 1 OF menuccp _screen.activeform.agregarFavorito(cForm, cTipo, cTitulo, cModulo)
			ELSE 
			    DEFINE BAR 1 OF menuccp PROMPT "Borrar Favorito"
			    ON SELECTION BAR 1 OF menuccp _screen.activeform.borrarFavorito(cForm,cTipo)
			ENDIF
			
		ACTIVATE POPUP menuccp 
		
	ENDPROC

		ENDDO

		nTop = 2

			nAlto = 80
		ENDIF

		this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.irPrimero()

				WITH &lbObject.				
					.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.Leer("Etiqueta"))
					.Width = nAncho
					.Height = nAlto
					.Visible = .T.
					
					.Top = nTop
					.Left = nLeft
					
					nTop = nTop + .height + 2
				ENDWITH
			ENDIF 
			this.oViewMenuTreeViewAll.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		this.AddObject("oViewMenuTreeViewAll", "tg_viewMenuTreeViewAll")
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].parentClass) = UPPER("Container") && OR UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].parentClass) = UPPER("Shape")
				thisform.Objects[i].visible = .F.
			ENDIF  
		ENDFOR 
		
		this.Visible = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].parentClass) = UPPER("Container")
				thisform.Objects[i].visible = .T.
			ENDIF  
		ENDFOR

		thisform.RemoveObject(this.Parent.Name)
	ENDPROC

			this.cargarModulos() && this.cargarModulos(cModulo, cNombreMenu)  MATIAS S. 16/02/17    
		ELSE 
			IF cModulo = "X" AND cNombreMenu = "Favoritos"
				IF this.hayFavoritos()
					lOcultar = .T.
				ENDIF 
				
				this.limpiarRecientes()
				this.limpiarFavoritos()
				
				IF !lOcultar
					this.cargarFavoritos()
				ENDIF 
			ELSE 
				IF cModulo = "X" AND cNombreMenu = "Recientes"
					IF this.hayRecientes()
						lOcultar = .T.
					ENDIF 
					
					this.limpiarRecientes()
					this.limpiarFavoritos()

						this.cargarRecientes()
					ENDIF 
				ELSE 
					this.cargarOpcionesModulo(cModulo, cNombreMenu, cEtiqueta)
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF

		*!*	LOCAL nCantBotonesDelMenu, nMaximoLenCaption, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nAnchos, nCantIdealLargoEx, nAltoExacto, nTopBase
		
		*!*	nAltoTotal = this.Height
		*!*	nTopInicial= 30
		*!*	nTopBase = 0
		*!*	nTop = nTopInicial
		*!*	nLeftInicial = 2
		*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*	nAncho = 200
		*!*	nAnchoChico = 100
		*!*	nAlto = 75
		*!*	nAltoChico = 50
		*!*	nCantidadBtn = 1
		
		*!*	nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		*!*	nMaximoLenCaption = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = 0
		*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		*!*	nAnchos = 0
		
		
		*!*	this.oVwModulos.Refrescar()
		*!*	this.oVwModulos.irPrimero()
		*!*	*!*	do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
		*!*	*!*		nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
		*!*	*!*		
		*!*	*!*		IF nMaximoLenCaption < LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")))
		*!*	*!*			nMaximoLenCaption = LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")))
		*!*	*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*		
		*!*	*!*		this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		*!*	*!*	ENDDO
		
		*!*	*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 1
		*!*	*!*	nCantIdealLargo = nCantBotonesDelMenu 
		
		*!*	*!*	*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 1
		*!*	*!*	*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 1
		*!*	*!*	*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		*!*	*!*	*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		*!*	*!*	*!*	DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
		*!*	*!*	*!*		IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
		*!*	*!*	*!*			lIdealEncontrado = .T.
		*!*	*!*	*!*		ELSE
		*!*	*!*	*!*			nCantIdealAncho = nCantIdealAncho + 1
		*!*	*!*	*!*			nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + 3/4
		*!*	*!*	*!*			nCantIdealLargo = ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
		*!*	*!*	*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*	*!*	ENDDO 
		
		*!*	*!*	nAncho = 40 
		*!*	*!*	nAltoExacto = 40
		*!*	*!*	nAlto = nAltoExacto
		
		*!*	*!*	nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - nAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*	*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		*!*	*!*	nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho + IIF(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) < 0.5 AND nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) <> 0,1,0),0)) / 2,0)
		*!*	*!*	nTop = nTopInicial 
		
		*!*	*!*	DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < 2
		*!*	*!*		**nAncho = nAncho - 1
		*!*	*!*		nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - 3/4
		*!*	*!*		nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
		*!*	*!*		**nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*	*!*		**nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*	*!*		
		*!*	*!*		nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho + IIF(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) < 0.5 AND nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) <> 0,1,0),0)) / 2,0)
		*!*	*!*		nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	*!*	ENDDO 
		
		
		*!*	do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
		*!*		nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
		*!*		
		*!*		IF nMaximoLenCaption < LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")))
		*!*			nMaximoLenCaption = LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")))
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*		this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		*!*	ENDDO
		
		*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 1
		*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 1
		*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		*!*	DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
		*!*		IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
		*!*			lIdealEncontrado = .T.
		*!*		ELSE
		*!*			nCantIdealAncho = nCantIdealAncho + 1
		*!*			**nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase)
		*!*			**nCantIdealLargo = ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*	ENDDO 		
		
		*!*	nAncho = 100
		*!*	nAltoExacto = 75 
		*!*	nAlto = nAltoExacto
		*!*	nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		*!*	nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - nTopBase - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		*!*	nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < (2 + nTopBase)
		*!*		nAncho = nAncho - 1
		*!*		nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase)
		*!*		nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
		*!*		nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*		
		*!*		nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - nTopBase - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		*!*		nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	ENDDO 
		
		
		*!*	this.oVwModulos.irPrimero()
		*!*	do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
		*!*		thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		
		*!*		lbObject = "oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
		*!*		DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2]
		*!*		thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = SUBSTR(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Nombre")),5,6)
		*!*		thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")
		*!*					
		*!*		IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta"))) <> "FAVORITOS"
		*!*			this.AddObject(lbObject,"tg_opcionMenu")
		*!*			
		*!*			lbObject = "this."+lbObject
		*!*			WITH &lbObject.
		*!*				.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta"))
		*!*				.Width = nAncho
		*!*				.Height = nAlto
		*!*				.Visible = .T.
		*!*				
		*!*				.Top = nTop - 28
		*!*				.Left= nLeft	
		*!*				
		*!*				nAnchos = nAnchos + 1
		*!*				IF nAnchos < nCantIdealAncho
		*!*					nLeft = nLeft + .Width + 4
		*!*				ELSE
		*!*					nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*					nAnchos = 0
		*!*					nTop = nTop + .height + 4
		*!*				ENDIF 
		*!*			ENDWITH
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*		this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		*!*	ENDDO
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargaropcionesmodulo
		lParameters cModulo, cNombreMenu, cEtiqueta
		LOCAL nCantBotonesDelMenu
		
		this.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
		
		nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		this.oVwOpciones.Refrescar(cModulo)
		this.oVwOpciones.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oVwOpciones.EsEof()
			IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menu"))) = UPPER(ALLTRIM(cNombreMenu)) 
				nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
			ENDIF 
			this.oVwOpciones.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		nLeft = 0
		nTop = 0
		
		**nAncho = INT(SYSMETRIC(1) / 7) && 200 MATIAS S. 16/02/17
		nAncho = thisform.oTbxBusqueda.width + thisform.oTbxBusqueda.left - this.left && MATIAS S. 16/02/17
		
		nLeftInicial = 2
		nAlto = 32
		*nAlto = INT((this.Height - nCantBotonesDelMenu * 2) / nCantBotonesDelMenu)
		**IF nAlto > 80
		**	nAlto = 80
		**ENDIF 
		
		this.oVwOpciones.Refrescar(cModulo)
		this.oVwOpciones.irPrimero()
		DO WHILE !this.oVwOpciones.EsEof()
		 	IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menu"))) = UPPER(ALLTRIM(cNombreMenu)) AND this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_tipoproceso") <> "EJE"
		 		thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		 		
				IF (this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_tipoproceso") = "SUB") 
					this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton)),"tg_opcionMenuTop")
				ELSE
					this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton)),"tg_abrirForm", this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_proceso"), this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))
				ENDIF 
				
				DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3]
				thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = cModulo
				thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menuLlamar")
				thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3] = ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("etiqueta"))
		
				lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
				WITH &lbObject.				
					.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("Etiqueta"))
					.Width = nAncho
					.Height = nAlto
					.Visible = .T.
					
					.Top = nTop
					.Left = nLeft
					
					nTop = nTop + .height + 2
				ENDWITH
			ENDIF 
			this.oVwOpciones.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		this.Width = nAncho + 10
		this.Height = nTop
		**_screen.activeform.olblRuta.top = this.Top + this.Height + 5
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		*!*	LOCAL nTop, nAltoTotal, nTopInicial, nLeft, nAncho, nAlto, nLeftInicial 
		*!*	LOCAL nCantBotonesDelMenu, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nCantIdealLargoEx, nAltoExacto, nTopBase, nCantIdealAnchoEx 
		*!*	nAltoTotal = this.Height
		
		*!*	nTopBase = this.oCmbVolver.Top + this.oCmbVolver.Height + 2
		
		*!*	nLeftInicial = 2
		*!*	nTop = nTopInicial
		*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*	nAlto = 75
		
		*!*	nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = 0
		*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		
		*!*	this.oVwOpciones.Refrescar(cModulo)
		*!*	this.oVwOpciones.irPrimero()
		*!*	do while !this.oVwOpciones.EsEof()
		*!*		IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menu"))) = UPPER(ALLTRIM(cNombreMenu)) 
		*!*			nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*		this.oVwOpciones.irSiguiente()
		*!*	ENDDO
		
		*!*	nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1 &&se agrega un btn volver como 1era opcion.
		
		*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 1
		*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 1
		*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		*!*	nCantIdealAnchoEx = nCantIdealAncho
		*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		*!*	DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
		*!*		IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealLargo <= nCantIdealAncho &&nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
		*!*			lIdealEncontrado = .T.
		*!*		ELSE
		*!*			nCantIdealAnchoEx = nCantIdealAncho + this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase) &&+ 1 
		*!*			nCantIdealAncho = INT(nCantIdealAnchoEx) &&+ 1 
		*!*			nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + 1 &&+ this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase)
		*!*			nCantIdealLargo = INT(nCantIdealLargoEx) &&ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*	ENDDO 		
		
		*!*	nAncho = 100
		*!*	nAltoExacto = 75 
		*!*	nAlto = nAltoExacto
		*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		*!*	nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - nTopBase - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		*!*	nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < (2 + nTopBase)
		*!*		nAncho = nAncho - 1
		*!*		nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase)
		*!*		nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
		*!*		nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*		
		*!*		nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - nTopBase - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		*!*		nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	ENDDO 
		*!*	 		
		*!*	this.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
		*!*	this.oLblMenu.Visible = .F.
		*!*	nLeft = 2
		*!*	nTop = 2
		*!*	nAncho = 180
		*!*	nLeftInicial = 2
		*!*	nAlto = INT((this.Height - nCantBotonesDelMenu * 2) / nCantBotonesDelMenu)
		*!*	IF nAlto > 80
		*!*		nAlto = 80
		*!*	ENDIF 
		
		*!*	thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		*!*	this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton)), "tg_volverMenu")
		
		*!*	DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3]
		*!*	thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = cModulo
		*!*	thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = UPPER(ALLTRIM(cNombreMenu))
		*!*	thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3] = cEtiqueta
		
		*!*	lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
		*!*	WITH &lbObject.				
		*!*		.Caption = ALLTRIM(cEtiqueta)
		*!*		.backColor = RGB(128, 128, 128)
		*!*		.Width = nAncho
		*!*		.Height = nAlto
		*!*		.Visible = .T.
		*!*		
		*!*		.Top = nTop
		*!*		.Left = nLeft
		*!*		
		*!*		nTop = nTop + .height + 2
		*!*	ENDWITH
		
		
		*!*	this.oVwOpciones.Refrescar(cModulo)
		*!*	this.oVwOpciones.irPrimero()
		*!*	DO WHILE !this.oVwOpciones.EsEof()
		*!*	 	IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menu"))) = UPPER(ALLTRIM(cNombreMenu)) 
		*!*	 		thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		*!*			IF (this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_tipoproceso") = "SUB") 
		*!*				this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton)),"tg_opcionMenuTop")
		*!*			ELSE
		*!*				this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton)),"tg_abrirForm", this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_proceso"), this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))
		*!*			ENDIF 
		*!*			
		*!*			DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3]
		*!*			thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = cModulo
		*!*			thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menuLlamar")
		*!*			thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3] = ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("etiqueta"))
		
		*!*			lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
		*!*			WITH &lbObject.				
		*!*				.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("Etiqueta"))
		*!*				.Width = nAncho
		*!*				.Height = nAlto
		*!*				.Visible = .T.
		*!*				
		*!*				.Top = nTop
		*!*				.Left = nLeft
		*!*				
		*!*				nTop = nTop + .height + 2
		*!*			ENDWITH
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*		this.oVwOpciones.irSiguiente()
		*!*	ENDDO
		
		*!*	this.idHasta = thisform.nIdBoton
		
		*!*	this.oLblMenu.Top = this.oCmbVolver.Top 
		*!*	this.oLblMenu.Left = this.oCmbVolver.Left + this.oCmbVolver.Width + 20
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarrecientes
		LOCAL nCantRecientes, lbCond, nCantBotonesDelMenu, nMaximoLenCaption, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nAnchos, nCantIdealLargoEx, nAltoExacto
		LOCAL nCantBotonesDelMenu, nControlesABorrar, vControlesABorrar
		DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[1]
		
		this.esRecientes = .T.
		
		this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.refrescar()
		nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.EsEof()
			nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
			this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		this.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
		nLeft = 0
		nTop = 0
		nAncho = thisform.oTbxBusqueda.width + thisform.oTbxBusqueda.left - thisform.oBtnVolver.left &&200 MATIAS S. 17/02/17
		
		nLeftInicial = 2
		nAlto = 32
		
		nControlesABorrar = 0
		FOR i = 1 TO this.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(this.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_abrirForm")
				nControlesABorrar = nControlesABorrar + 1
				DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar]
				vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar] = this.Objects[i].name
			ENDIF 
		ENDFOR 
		
		IF nControlesABorrar > 0
			FOR i = 1 TO ALEN(vControlesABorrar,1)
				this.RemoveObject(vControlesABorrar[i])
			ENDFOR 
		ENDIF 
		
		
		nCantRecientes = 0
		this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.EsEof() AND nCantRecientes < 15
		
			&& IF AGREGADO PARA TOMAR LOS PERMISOS DE LOS USUARIOS 07/05/2018
			IF (oApp.PedirPermiso(ALLTRIM(this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.Leer("id_tipoproceso")),ALLTRIM(this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.Leer("objeto")),.f.,.f.,oApp.CodUsuario())) 
				nCantRecientes = nCantRecientes + 1
		
				IF TYPE("this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantRecientes))) = "O"
					this.RemoveObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantRecientes)))
				ENDIF 
				
				this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantRecientes)),"tg_abrirForm", this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.leer("objeto"), this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))
				
				lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantRecientes))
				WITH &lbObject.
				
					.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.Leer("titulo"))
					.Width = nAncho
					.Height = nAlto
					.Visible = .T.
					
					.Top = nTop
					.Left= nLeft
						
					nTop = nTop + .Height + 2
				ENDWITH
			ENDIF
						
			this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
	ENDPROC

	HIDDEN PROCEDURE gjm_redimensionaobjetos		&& Metodo Principal para redirmensionar lso objetos y moverse
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE hayfavoritos
		LOCAL lHayFavoritos
		
		lHayFavoritos = .F.
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND thisform.Objects[i].esFavoritos
				lHayFavoritos = .T.
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		RETURN lHayFavoritos
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE hayrecientes
		LOCAL lHayRecientes
		
		lHayRecientes = .F.
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND thisform.Objects[i].esRecientes
				lHayRecientes = .T.
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		RETURN lHayRecientes
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		this.addobject("oVwModulos"			,"tg_viewMenuTreeviewModulos")
		this.addobject("oVwOpciones"		,"tg_viewMenuTreeview")
		this.addobject("oTblFavoritos"		, "tg_tabla", "menufavoritos", "CLAVE")
		this.AddObject("oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario", "tg_viewFormsRecientesDelUsuario")
		
		*!*	FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
		*!*		IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Name) <> UPPER("oContModulos")
		*!*			thisform.Objects[i].visible = .F.
		*!*		ENDIF  
		*!*	ENDFOR 
		
		*!*	this.Visible = .T.
		this.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
		
		this.esFavoritos = .F.
		this.esRecientes = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE limpiar
		*!*	LOCAL i
		*!*	FOR i = this.idDesde TO this.idHasta
		*!*		this.RemoveObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(i)))
		*!*	ENDFOR 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE limpiarfavoritos
		LOCAL nControlesABorrar, nCantidadControles, vControlesABorrar
		DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[1]
		
		nControlesABorrar = 0
		nCantidadControles = thisform.Objects.count
		FOR i = 1 to nCantidadControles
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND thisform.Objects[i].esFavoritos
				nControlesABorrar = nControlesABorrar + 1
				DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar]
				vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar] = thisform.Objects[i].name
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		IF nControlesABorrar > 0
			FOR i = 1 TO ALEN(vControlesABorrar,1)
				thisform.RemoveObject(vControlesABorrar[i])
			ENDFOR 
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE limpiarrecientes
		LOCAL nControlesABorrar, nCantidadControles, vControlesABorrar
		DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[1]
		
		nControlesABorrar = 0
		nCantidadControles = thisform.Objects.count
		FOR i = 1 to nCantidadControles
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND thisform.Objects[i].esRecientes
				nControlesABorrar = nControlesABorrar + 1
				DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar]
				vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar] = thisform.Objects[i].name
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		IF nControlesABorrar > 0
			FOR i = 1 TO ALEN(vControlesABorrar,1)
				thisform.RemoveObject(vControlesABorrar[i])
			ENDFOR 
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ocultarotroscontenedores
		LOCAL i
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Name) <> UPPER("oContModulos") AND thisform.Objects[i].left = this.left
				thisform.Objects[i].visible = .F.
			ENDIF  
		ENDFOR 
		
		this.Visible = .T.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Resize
		  
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmbVolver.Click
		thisform.cantContenedores = thisform.cantContenedores - 1
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].name) = UPPER("oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores)))
				thisform.Objects[i].visible = .T.
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		thisform.RemoveObject(this.Parent.Name)
		
		
		
		*!*	this.Visible = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTimerRecientes.Timer
		this.Parent.cargarRecientes()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_modulostopold AS container 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="container" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="oCmbVolver" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="oTimerRecientes" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: cargarbotones
		*m: cargarfavoritos
		*m: cargarmodulos
		*m: cargaropcionesmodulo
		*m: cargarrecientes

		*m: hayfavoritos
		*m: hayrecientes
		*m: limpiar

		*m: limpiarrecientes
		*m: ocultarotroscontenedores
		*p: esfavoritos
		*p: esrecientes

		*p: gjm_initclickx		&& Guarda la cordenada X del momento en que se comienza el arrastre
		*p: iddesde
		*p: idhasta
		*p: modulo
		*p: nombremenu
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		BackColor = 255,255,255

		BorderWidth = 0
		esfavoritos = .F.
		esrecientes = .F.

	*</PropValue>

	ADD OBJECT 'oCmbVolver' AS tg_commandbutton WITH ;
		BackColor = 255,255,255, ;
		Caption = "", ;
		Height = 35, ;
		Left = 5, ;
		Name = "oCmbVolver", ;
		Picture = ..\bmp\atraseiffelxxi.png, ;
		PicturePosition = 13, ;
		SpecialEffect = 1, ;
		Top = 10, ;
		Width = 44
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="commandbutton" />

	ADD OBJECT 'oTimerRecientes' AS timer WITH ;
		Height = 23, ;
		Left = 240, ;

		Width = 23
		*< END OBJECT: BaseClass="timer" />
	
	PROCEDURE cargarbotones
		lParameters cModulo, cNombreMenu, cEtiqueta, lOcultar
		
		this.modulo = cModulo
		this.nombreMenu = cNombreMenu
		this.etiqueta = cEtiqueta
		lOcultar = .F.
		
		IF TYPE("cModulo") = "C" AND cModulo = "PRINCIPAL"
			this.cargarModulos() && this.cargarModulos(cModulo, cNombreMenu)  MATIAS S. 16/02/17    
		ELSE 
			IF cModulo = "X" AND cNombreMenu = "Favoritos"
				IF this.hayFavoritos()
					lOcultar = .T.
				ENDIF 
				
				this.limpiarRecientes()
				this.limpiarFavoritos()
				
				IF !lOcultar
					this.cargarFavoritos()
				ENDIF 
			ELSE 
				IF cModulo = "X" AND cNombreMenu = "Recientes"
					IF this.hayRecientes()
						lOcultar = .T.
					ENDIF 
					
					this.limpiarRecientes()
					this.limpiarFavoritos()
					
					IF !lOcultar
						this.cargarRecientes()
					ENDIF 
				ELSE 
					this.cargarOpcionesModulo(cModulo, cNombreMenu, cEtiqueta)
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF 
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarfavoritos
		LOCAL lbCond, nCantBotonesDelMenu, nLeft, nTop, nAncho, nAlto, lbObject
		Local i, nCantidadControles, vControlesABorrar, nControlesABorrar
		
		*!*	vControlesABorrar = .F.
		this.esFavoritos = .T.
		
		
		this.oTblFavoritos.filtrar("id_usuario = '" + oApp.CodUsuario() +"'")
		
		nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		this.oTblFavoritos.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oTblFavoritos.EsEof()
			nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
			this.oTblFavoritos.irSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		this.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
		nLeft = 0
		nTop = 0
		nAncho = thisform.oTbxBusqueda.width + thisform.oTbxBusqueda.left - thisform.oBtnVolver.left &&200 MATIAS S. 17/02/17
		
		nLeftInicial = 2
		nAlto = 32
		
		nControlesABorrar = 0
		FOR i = 1 TO this.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(this.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_abrirForm")
				nControlesABorrar = nControlesABorrar + 1
				DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar]
				vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar] = this.Objects[i].name
			ENDIF 
		ENDFOR 
		
		IF nControlesABorrar > 0
			FOR i = 1 TO ALEN(vControlesABorrar,1)
				this.RemoveObject(vControlesABorrar[i])
			ENDFOR 
		ENDIF 
		
		
		nCantFavoritos = 0
		this.oTblFavoritos.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oTblFavoritos.EsEof()
		
			nCantFavoritos = nCantFavoritos + 1
		
			this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantFavoritos)),"tg_abrirForm", this.oTblFavoritos.Leer("id_proceso"), this.oTblFavoritos.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))
			
			lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantFavoritos))
			WITH &lbObject.
		
				.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oTblFavoritos.Leer("opcion"))
				.Width = nAncho
				.Height = nAlto
				.Visible = .T.
				
				.Top = nTop
				.Left= nLeft
				
				nTop = nTop + .Height + 2 
			ENDWITH
					
			this.oTblFavoritos.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarmodulos
		**lParameters cModulo, cNombreMenu  MATIAS S. 16/02/17    
		LOCAL lbObject, nAncho, nAlto, nLeft, nTop, nCantModulos, nDistanciaEntreBotones, nTamanioLetra, cNombreLetra
		
		nCantModulos = 0
		this.oVwModulos.Refrescar()
		this.oVwModulos.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
			nCantModulos = nCantModulos + 1
			this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO 
		
		nAncho = INT((SYSMETRIC(1) - 100) / (nCantModulos + 2)) && 130       MATIAS S. 16/02/17    
		nAlto = INT(SYSMETRIC(2)/25) && 30       MATIAS S. 16/02/17    
		nLeft = 0
		nTop = 0 
		
		
		nTamanioLetra = nAncho / 10 && 13      MATIAS S. 16/02/17    
		IF nTamanioLetra > 18
			nTamanioLetra = 18
		ENDIF 
		cNombreLetra = "Tahoma"
		
		** CARGO MODULOS **
		this.oVwModulos.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
		
			thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		
			lbObject = "oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
			DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3]
			thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = SUBSTR(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("nombre")),5,6)
			thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = this.oVwModulos.Leer("menuLlamar")
			thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3] = ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("etiqueta"))
						
			IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta"))) <> "FAVORITOS"
				this.AddObject(lbObject,"tg_opcionMenuTOP", .T., .F.) && lEsModulo, lUbicarDerecha
				
				lbObject = "this."+lbObject
				WITH &lbObject.
					.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta"))
					.Alignment = 2
					.Width = nAncho
					.Height = nAlto
					.Visible = .T.
					.FontSize = nTamanioLetra 
					.FontName = cNombreLetra 
					.ForeColor = RGB(255,255,255)
					
					IF !this.oVwModulos.Leer("visible")
						.Enabled = .F.
						.BackColor = RGB(128,128,128)
					ENDIF 
					
					.Top = nTop
					.Left= nLeft
				
					nLeft = nLeft + nAncho - 2
				ENDWITH
			ENDIF 
			
			this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		** CARGO MODULOS **
		
		** CARGO MODULO FAVORITOS **
		thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		lbObject = "oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
		DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3]
		thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = "X"
		thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = "Favoritos"
		thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3] = "Favoritos"
		lbObject = "oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
		this.AddObject(lbObject,"tg_opcionMenuTOP", .F., .T.) && lEsModulo, lUbicarDerecha
		lbObject = "this."+lbObject
		WITH &lbObject.
			.Caption = "Favoritos"
			.Width = nAncho
			.Height = nAlto
			.Alignment = 2
			.Visible = .T.
			.FontSize = 10	
			.Top = nTop
			.Left= nLeft
			.FontSize = nTamanioLetra 
			.FontName = cNombreLetra 
			.ForeColor = RGB(255,255,255)
		
			nLeft = nLeft + nAncho - 2
		ENDWITH
		** CARGO MODULO FAVORITOS **
		
		** CARGO MODULO RECIENTES **
		thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		lbObject = "oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
		DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3]
		thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = "X"
		thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = "Recientes"
		thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3] = "Recientes"
		lbObject = "oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
		this.AddObject(lbObject,"tg_opcionMenuTOP", .F., .T.) && lEsModulo, lUbicarDerecha
		lbObject = "this."+lbObject
		WITH &lbObject.
			.Caption = "Recientes"
			.Width = nAncho
			.Height = nAlto
			.Alignment = 2
			.Visible = .T.
			.FontSize = 10	
			.Top = nTop
			.Left= nLeft
			.FontSize = nTamanioLetra 
			.FontName = cNombreLetra 
			.ForeColor = RGB(255,255,255)
		
			nLeft = nLeft + nAncho
		ENDWITH
		** CARGO MODULO RECIENTES **
		
		
		this.Width = nLeft + 10
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		*!*	LOCAL nTop, nAltoTotal, nTopInicial, nLeft, nAncho, nAlto, nCantidadBtn, nAnchoChico, nAltoChico, nLeftInicial 
		*!*	LOCAL nCantBotonesDelMenu, nMaximoLenCaption, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nAnchos, nCantIdealLargoEx, nAltoExacto, nTopBase
		
		*!*	nAltoTotal = this.Height
		*!*	nTopInicial= 30
		*!*	nTopBase = 0
		*!*	nTop = nTopInicial
		*!*	nLeftInicial = 2
		*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*	nAncho = 200
		*!*	nAnchoChico = 100
		*!*	nAlto = 75
		*!*	nAltoChico = 50
		*!*	nCantidadBtn = 1
		
		*!*	nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		*!*	nMaximoLenCaption = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = 0
		*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		*!*	nAnchos = 0
		
		
		*!*	this.oVwModulos.Refrescar()
		*!*	this.oVwModulos.irPrimero()
		*!*	*!*	do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
		*!*	*!*		nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
		*!*	*!*		
		*!*	*!*		IF nMaximoLenCaption < LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")))
		*!*	*!*			nMaximoLenCaption = LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")))
		*!*	*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*		
		*!*	*!*		this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		*!*	*!*	ENDDO
		
		*!*	*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 1
		*!*	*!*	nCantIdealLargo = nCantBotonesDelMenu 
		
		*!*	*!*	*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 1
		*!*	*!*	*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 1
		*!*	*!*	*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		*!*	*!*	*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		*!*	*!*	*!*	DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
		*!*	*!*	*!*		IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
		*!*	*!*	*!*			lIdealEncontrado = .T.
		*!*	*!*	*!*		ELSE
		*!*	*!*	*!*			nCantIdealAncho = nCantIdealAncho + 1
		*!*	*!*	*!*			nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + 3/4
		*!*	*!*	*!*			nCantIdealLargo = ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
		*!*	*!*	*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*	*!*	*!*	ENDDO 
		
		*!*	*!*	nAncho = 40 
		*!*	*!*	nAltoExacto = 40
		*!*	*!*	nAlto = nAltoExacto
		
		*!*	*!*	nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - nAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*	*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		*!*	*!*	nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho + IIF(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) < 0.5 AND nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) <> 0,1,0),0)) / 2,0)
		*!*	*!*	nTop = nTopInicial 
		
		*!*	*!*	DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < 2
		*!*	*!*		**nAncho = nAncho - 1
		*!*	*!*		nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - 3/4
		*!*	*!*		nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
		*!*	*!*		**nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*	*!*		**nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*	*!*		
		*!*	*!*		nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho + IIF(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) < 0.5 AND nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho - INT(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho) <> 0,1,0),0)) / 2,0)
		*!*	*!*		nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	*!*	ENDDO 
		
		
		*!*	do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
		*!*		nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
		*!*		
		*!*		IF nMaximoLenCaption < LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")))
		*!*			nMaximoLenCaption = LEN(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")))
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*		this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		*!*	ENDDO
		
		*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 1
		*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 1
		*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		*!*	DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
		*!*		IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
		*!*			lIdealEncontrado = .T.
		*!*		ELSE
		*!*			nCantIdealAncho = nCantIdealAncho + 1
		*!*			**nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase)
		*!*			**nCantIdealLargo = ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*	ENDDO 		
		
		*!*	nAncho = 100
		*!*	nAltoExacto = 75 
		*!*	nAlto = nAltoExacto
		*!*	nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		*!*	nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - nTopBase - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		*!*	nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < (2 + nTopBase)
		*!*		nAncho = nAncho - 1
		*!*		nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase)
		*!*		nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
		*!*		nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*		
		*!*		nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - nTopBase - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		*!*		nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	ENDDO 
		
		
		*!*	this.oVwModulos.irPrimero()
		*!*	do while !this.oVwModulos.EsEof()
		*!*		thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		
		*!*		lbObject = "oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
		*!*		DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2]
		*!*		thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = SUBSTR(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Nombre")),5,6)
		*!*		thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta")
		*!*					
		*!*		IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta"))) <> "FAVORITOS"
		*!*			this.AddObject(lbObject,"tg_opcionMenu")
		*!*			
		*!*			lbObject = "this."+lbObject
		*!*			WITH &lbObject.
		*!*				.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oVwModulos.Leer("Etiqueta"))
		*!*				.Width = nAncho
		*!*				.Height = nAlto
		*!*				.Visible = .T.
		*!*				
		*!*				.Top = nTop - 28
		*!*				.Left= nLeft	
		*!*				
		*!*				nAnchos = nAnchos + 1
		*!*				IF nAnchos < nCantIdealAncho
		*!*					nLeft = nLeft + .Width + 4
		*!*				ELSE
		*!*					nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*					nAnchos = 0
		*!*					nTop = nTop + .height + 4
		*!*				ENDIF 
		*!*			ENDWITH
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*		this.oVwModulos.irSiguiente()
		*!*	ENDDO
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargaropcionesmodulo
		lParameters cModulo, cNombreMenu, cEtiqueta
		LOCAL nCantBotonesDelMenu
		
		this.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
		
		nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		this.oVwOpciones.Refrescar(cModulo)
		this.oVwOpciones.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oVwOpciones.EsEof()
			IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menu"))) = UPPER(ALLTRIM(cNombreMenu)) 
				nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
			ENDIF 
			this.oVwOpciones.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		nLeft = 0
		nTop = 0
		
		**nAncho = INT(SYSMETRIC(1) / 7) && 200 MATIAS S. 16/02/17
		nAncho = thisform.oTbxBusqueda.width + thisform.oTbxBusqueda.left - this.left && MATIAS S. 16/02/17
		
		nLeftInicial = 2
		nAlto = 32
		*nAlto = INT((this.Height - nCantBotonesDelMenu * 2) / nCantBotonesDelMenu)
		**IF nAlto > 80
		**	nAlto = 80
		**ENDIF 
		
		this.oVwOpciones.Refrescar(cModulo)
		this.oVwOpciones.irPrimero()
		DO WHILE !this.oVwOpciones.EsEof()
		 	IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menu"))) = UPPER(ALLTRIM(cNombreMenu)) AND this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_tipoproceso") <> "EJE"
		 		thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		 		
				IF (this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_tipoproceso") = "SUB") 
					this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton)),"tg_opcionMenuTop")
				ELSE
					this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton)),"tg_abrirForm", this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_proceso"), this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))
				ENDIF 
				
				DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3]
				thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = cModulo
				thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menuLlamar")
				thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3] = ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("etiqueta"))
		
				lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
				WITH &lbObject.				
					.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("Etiqueta"))
					.Width = nAncho
					.Height = nAlto
					.Visible = .T.
					
					.Top = nTop
					.Left = nLeft
					
					nTop = nTop + .height + 2
				ENDWITH
			ENDIF 
			this.oVwOpciones.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		this.Width = nAncho + 10
		this.Height = nTop
		**_screen.activeform.olblRuta.top = this.Top + this.Height + 5
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		*!*	LOCAL nTop, nAltoTotal, nTopInicial, nLeft, nAncho, nAlto, nLeftInicial 
		*!*	LOCAL nCantBotonesDelMenu, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nCantIdealLargoEx, nAltoExacto, nTopBase, nCantIdealAnchoEx 
		*!*	nAltoTotal = this.Height
		
		*!*	nTopBase = this.oCmbVolver.Top + this.oCmbVolver.Height + 2
		
		*!*	nLeftInicial = 2
		*!*	nTop = nTopInicial
		*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*	nAlto = 75
		
		*!*	nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 0
		*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = 0
		*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		
		*!*	this.oVwOpciones.Refrescar(cModulo)
		*!*	this.oVwOpciones.irPrimero()
		*!*	do while !this.oVwOpciones.EsEof()
		*!*		IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menu"))) = UPPER(ALLTRIM(cNombreMenu)) 
		*!*			nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*		this.oVwOpciones.irSiguiente()
		*!*	ENDDO
		
		*!*	nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1 &&se agrega un btn volver como 1era opcion.
		
		*!*	nCantIdealAncho = 1
		*!*	nCantIdealLargo = 1
		*!*	nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargo 
		*!*	nCantIdealAnchoEx = nCantIdealAncho
		*!*	lIdealEncontrado = .F.
		*!*	DO WHILE !lIdealEncontrado
		*!*		IF nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealLargo <= nCantIdealAncho &&nCantBotonesDelMenu / nCantIdealAncho <= nCantIdealLargo
		*!*			lIdealEncontrado = .T.
		*!*		ELSE
		*!*			nCantIdealAnchoEx = nCantIdealAncho + this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase) &&+ 1 
		*!*			nCantIdealAncho = INT(nCantIdealAnchoEx) &&+ 1 
		*!*			nCantIdealLargoEx = nCantIdealLargoEx + 1 &&+ this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase)
		*!*			nCantIdealLargo = INT(nCantIdealLargoEx) &&ROUND(nCantIdealLargoEx,0)
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*	ENDDO 		
		
		*!*	nAncho = 100
		*!*	nAltoExacto = 75 
		*!*	nAlto = nAltoExacto
		*!*	nLeft = nLeftInicial
		
		*!*	nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - nTopBase - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		*!*	nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	DO WHILE nLeftInicial < 2 OR nTopInicial < (2 + nTopBase)
		*!*		nAncho = nAncho - 1
		*!*		nAltoExacto = nAltoExacto - this.Width / (this.Height - nTopBase)
		*!*		nAlto = ROUND(nAltoExacto,0)
		
		*!*		nLeftInicial = ROUND((this.Width - (nAncho + 4 ) * nCantIdealAncho) / 2,0)
		*!*		nLeft = nLeftInicial
		*!*		
		*!*		nTopInicial = ROUND((this.Height - nTopBase - (nAlto + 4 ) * ROUND(nCantBotonesDelMenu/nCantIdealAncho,0)) / 2,0)
		*!*		nTop = nTopInicial 
		*!*	ENDDO 
		*!*	 		
		*!*	this.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
		*!*	this.oLblMenu.Visible = .F.
		*!*	nLeft = 2
		*!*	nTop = 2
		*!*	nAncho = 180
		*!*	nLeftInicial = 2
		*!*	nAlto = INT((this.Height - nCantBotonesDelMenu * 2) / nCantBotonesDelMenu)
		*!*	IF nAlto > 80
		*!*		nAlto = 80
		*!*	ENDIF 
		
		*!*	thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		*!*	this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton)), "tg_volverMenu")
		
		*!*	DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3]
		*!*	thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = cModulo
		*!*	thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = UPPER(ALLTRIM(cNombreMenu))
		*!*	thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3] = cEtiqueta
		
		*!*	lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
		*!*	WITH &lbObject.				
		*!*		.Caption = ALLTRIM(cEtiqueta)
		*!*		.backColor = RGB(128, 128, 128)
		*!*		.Width = nAncho
		*!*		.Height = nAlto
		*!*		.Visible = .T.
		*!*		
		*!*		.Top = nTop
		*!*		.Left = nLeft
		*!*		
		*!*		nTop = nTop + .height + 2
		*!*	ENDWITH
		
		
		*!*	this.oVwOpciones.Refrescar(cModulo)
		*!*	this.oVwOpciones.irPrimero()
		*!*	DO WHILE !this.oVwOpciones.EsEof()
		*!*	 	IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menu"))) = UPPER(ALLTRIM(cNombreMenu)) 
		*!*	 		thisform.nIdBoton = thisform.nIdBoton + 1
		*!*			IF (this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_tipoproceso") = "SUB") 
		*!*				this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton)),"tg_opcionMenuTop")
		*!*			ELSE
		*!*				this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton)),"tg_abrirForm", this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_proceso"), this.oVwOpciones.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))
		*!*			ENDIF 
		*!*			
		*!*			DIMENSION thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3]
		*!*			thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 1] = cModulo
		*!*			thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 2] = this.oVwOpciones.Leer("menuLlamar")
		*!*			thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[thisform.nIdBoton, 3] = ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("etiqueta"))
		
		*!*			lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.nIdBoton))
		*!*			WITH &lbObject.				
		*!*				.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oVwOpciones.Leer("Etiqueta"))
		*!*				.Width = nAncho
		*!*				.Height = nAlto
		*!*				.Visible = .T.
		*!*				
		*!*				.Top = nTop
		*!*				.Left = nLeft
		*!*				
		*!*				nTop = nTop + .height + 2
		*!*			ENDWITH
		*!*		ENDIF 
		*!*		this.oVwOpciones.irSiguiente()
		*!*	ENDDO
		
		*!*	this.idHasta = thisform.nIdBoton
		
		*!*	this.oLblMenu.Top = this.oCmbVolver.Top 
		*!*	this.oLblMenu.Left = this.oCmbVolver.Left + this.oCmbVolver.Width + 20
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarrecientes
		LOCAL nCantRecientes, lbCond, nCantBotonesDelMenu, nMaximoLenCaption, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nAnchos, nCantIdealLargoEx, nAltoExacto
		LOCAL nCantBotonesDelMenu, nControlesABorrar, vControlesABorrar
		DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[1]
		
		this.esRecientes = .T.
		
		this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.refrescar()
		nCantBotonesDelMenu = 0
		this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.EsEof()
			nCantBotonesDelMenu = nCantBotonesDelMenu + 1
			this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		this.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
		nLeft = 0
		nTop = 0
		nAncho = thisform.oTbxBusqueda.width + thisform.oTbxBusqueda.left - thisform.oBtnVolver.left &&200 MATIAS S. 17/02/17
		
		nLeftInicial = 2
		nAlto = 32
		
		nControlesABorrar = 0
		FOR i = 1 TO this.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(this.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_abrirForm")
				nControlesABorrar = nControlesABorrar + 1
				DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar]
				vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar] = this.Objects[i].name
			ENDIF 
		ENDFOR 
		
		IF nControlesABorrar > 0
			FOR i = 1 TO ALEN(vControlesABorrar,1)
				this.RemoveObject(vControlesABorrar[i])
			ENDFOR 
		ENDIF 
		
		
		nCantRecientes = 0
		this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.EsEof() AND nCantRecientes < 15
		
			nCantRecientes = nCantRecientes + 1
		
			IF TYPE("this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantRecientes))) = "O"
				this.RemoveObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantRecientes)))
			ENDIF 
			
			this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantRecientes)),"tg_abrirForm", this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.leer("objeto"), this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))
			
			lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantRecientes))
			WITH &lbObject.
			
				.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.Leer("titulo"))
				.Width = nAncho
				.Height = nAlto
				.Visible = .T.
				
				.Top = nTop
				.Left= nLeft
					
				nTop = nTop + .Height + 2
			ENDWITH
					
			this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
	ENDPROC

	HIDDEN PROCEDURE gjm_redimensionaobjetos		&& Metodo Principal para redirmensionar lso objetos y moverse
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE hayfavoritos
		LOCAL lHayFavoritos
		
		lHayFavoritos = .F.
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND thisform.Objects[i].esFavoritos
				lHayFavoritos = .T.
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		RETURN lHayFavoritos
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE hayrecientes
		LOCAL lHayRecientes
		
		lHayRecientes = .F.
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND thisform.Objects[i].esRecientes
				lHayRecientes = .T.
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		RETURN lHayRecientes
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		this.addobject("oVwModulos"			,"tg_viewMenuTreeviewModulos")
		this.addobject("oVwOpciones"		,"tg_viewMenuTreeview")
		this.addobject("oTblFavoritos"		, "tg_tabla", "menufavoritos", "CLAVE")
		this.AddObject("oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario", "tg_viewFormsRecientesDelUsuario")
		
		*!*	FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
		*!*		IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Name) <> UPPER("oContModulos")
		*!*			thisform.Objects[i].visible = .F.
		*!*		ENDIF  
		*!*	ENDFOR 
		
		*!*	this.Visible = .T.
		this.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
		
		this.esFavoritos = .F.
		this.esRecientes = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE limpiar
		*!*	LOCAL i
		*!*	FOR i = this.idDesde TO this.idHasta
		*!*		this.RemoveObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(i)))
		*!*	ENDFOR 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE limpiarfavoritos
		LOCAL nControlesABorrar, nCantidadControles, vControlesABorrar
		DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[1]
		
		nControlesABorrar = 0
		nCantidadControles = thisform.Objects.count
		FOR i = 1 to nCantidadControles
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND thisform.Objects[i].esFavoritos
				nControlesABorrar = nControlesABorrar + 1
				DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar]
				vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar] = thisform.Objects[i].name
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		IF nControlesABorrar > 0
			FOR i = 1 TO ALEN(vControlesABorrar,1)
				thisform.RemoveObject(vControlesABorrar[i])
			ENDFOR 
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE limpiarrecientes
		LOCAL nControlesABorrar, nCantidadControles, vControlesABorrar
		DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[1]
		
		nControlesABorrar = 0
		nCantidadControles = thisform.Objects.count
		FOR i = 1 to nCantidadControles
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND thisform.Objects[i].esRecientes
				nControlesABorrar = nControlesABorrar + 1
				DIMENSION vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar]
				vControlesABorrar[nControlesABorrar] = thisform.Objects[i].name
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		IF nControlesABorrar > 0
			FOR i = 1 TO ALEN(vControlesABorrar,1)
				thisform.RemoveObject(vControlesABorrar[i])
			ENDFOR 
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ocultarotroscontenedores
		LOCAL i
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Name) <> UPPER("oContModulos") AND thisform.Objects[i].left = this.left
				thisform.Objects[i].visible = .F.
			ENDIF  
		ENDFOR 
		
		this.Visible = .T.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Resize
		  
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmbVolver.Click
		thisform.cantContenedores = thisform.cantContenedores - 1
		
		FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
			IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].name) = UPPER("oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores)))
				thisform.Objects[i].visible = .T.
			ENDIF
		ENDFOR
		
		thisform.RemoveObject(this.Parent.Name)
		
		
		
		*!*	this.Visible = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTimerRecientes.Timer
		this.Parent.cargarRecientes()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_opcionmenutop AS commandbutton 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="commandbutton" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*p: esmodulo
		*p: ocontopcionesmodulo
		*p: ubicarderecha
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		BackColor = 32,154,29
		Caption = "Prueba"
		esmodulo = .F.
		FontName = "Tahoma"
		FontSize = 9
		ForeColor = 255,255,255
		Height = 105
		MousePointer = 15
		Name = "tg_opcionmenutop"
		ocontopcionesmodulo = .F.
		PicturePosition = 13
		SpecialEffect = 1
		Style = 0
		ubicarderecha = .F.
		Width = 207
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE Click
		LOCAL cNuevoContenedor, nBtn, nBackColor
		
		IF this.esModulo AND ALLTRIM(UPPER(this.Parent.Class)) = ALLTRIM(UPPER("tg_modulosTop"))
			IF thisform.oTblEmpresas.buscar(oApp.IdEmpresa, .F., "CLAVE")
				IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
					FOR nBtn = 1 TO this.Parent.Objects.Count
						IF ALLTRIM(UPPER(this.Parent.Objects[nBtn].Class)) = ALLTRIM(UPPER("tg_opcionMenuTop")) AND this.Parent.Objects[nBtn].esModulo
							this.Parent.Objects[nBtn].backcolor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
						ENDIF
					ENDFOR
					
					this.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnMenu")
					_screen.activeform.olblRuta.caption = ""
				ENDIF
			ENDIF
		ENDIF
		
		IF this.ubicarDerecha AND ALLTRIM(UPPER(this.Parent.Class)) = ALLTRIM(UPPER("tg_modulosTop"))
			IF thisform.oTblEmpresas.buscar(oApp.IdEmpresa, .F., "CLAVE")
				IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
					FOR nBtn = 1 TO this.Parent.Objects.Count
						IF ALLTRIM(UPPER(this.Parent.Objects[nBtn].Class)) = ALLTRIM(UPPER("tg_opcionMenuTop")) AND this.Parent.Objects[nBtn].ubicarDerecha AND this.Parent.Objects[nBtn] <> this
							this.Parent.Objects[nBtn].backcolor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
						ENDIF
					ENDFOR
					
					IF this.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnMenu")
						this.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
					ELSE 
						this.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnMenu")
					ENDIF 
				ENDIF
			ENDIF
		ENDIF
		
		IF this.ubicarDerecha 
			thisform.cantContenedoresDerecha = thisform.cantContenedoresDerecha + 1
			cNuevoContenedor = "oContOpcionesDerecha" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedoresDerecha))
		ELSE
			IF this.esModulo
				oApp.eliminarContOpcionesMenu()
			ENDIF 
			thisform.cantContenedores = thisform.cantContenedores + 1
			cNuevoContenedor = "oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores))
		ENDIF 
		
		thisform.AddObject(cNuevoContenedor, "tg_modulosTOP")
		cNuevoContenedor = "thisform." + cNuevoContenedor
		WITH &cNuevoContenedor.
			.top = thisform.oContOpciones1.top
			.width = thisform.oContOpciones1.width 
			.height = thisform.oContOpciones1.height 
			
			IF this.ubicarDerecha 
				.left = SYSMETRIC(1) - .width - 10
			ELSE
				.left = thisform.oContOpciones1.left 
			ENDIF 
			
			IF AT("Derecha",cNuevoContenedor) = 0
				IF !EMPTY(_screen.activeform.olblRuta.caption)
					_screen.activeform.olblRuta.caption = _screen.activeform.olblRuta.caption + " > "
				ENDIF 
				_screen.activeform.olblRuta.caption = _screen.activeform.olblRuta.caption + ALLTRIM(this.Caption)
			ENDIF 
			
			.ocultarOtrosContenedores()
			.cargarBotones(thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Name,5,LEN(this.name)))), 1], thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Name,5,LEN(this.name)))), 2], thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Name,5,LEN(this.name)))), 3])
		ENDWITH
		
		thisform.oTbxBusqueda.setFocus()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LPARAMETERS lEsModulo, lUbicarDerecha
		
		this.esModulo = lEsModulo
		this.ubicarDerecha = lUbicarDerecha
		
		this.WordWrap = .T.
		
		IF thisform.oTblEmpresas.buscar(oApp.IdEmpresa, .F., "CLAVE")
			IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
				this.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
				this.ForeColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorLetraFinal")
			ELSE
				this.BackColor = RGB(229,20,0)
				this.ForeColor = RGB(255,255,255)
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF 
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE MouseEnter
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		**this.BackColor = RGB(21,100,19)
		
		**this.BackColor = this.BackColor + 40
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE MouseLeave
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		**this.BackColor = RGB(32,154,29)
		
		**this.BackColor = this.BackColor - 40
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_opcionmenutopold AS commandbutton 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="commandbutton" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*p: esmodulo
		*p: ocontopcionesmodulo
		*p: ubicarderecha
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		BackColor = 32,154,29
		Caption = "Prueba"
		esmodulo = .F.
		FontName = "Tahoma"
		FontSize = 9
		ForeColor = 255,255,255
		Height = 105
		MousePointer = 15
		Name = "tg_opcionmenutop"
		ocontopcionesmodulo = .F.
		PicturePosition = 13
		SpecialEffect = 1
		Style = 0
		ubicarderecha = .F.
		Width = 207
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE Click
		LOCAL cNuevoContenedor, nBtn, nBackColor
		
		IF this.esModulo AND ALLTRIM(UPPER(this.Parent.Class)) = ALLTRIM(UPPER("tg_modulosTop"))
			IF thisform.oTblEmpresas.buscar(oApp.IdEmpresa, .F., "CLAVE")
				IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
					FOR nBtn = 1 TO this.Parent.Objects.Count
						IF ALLTRIM(UPPER(this.Parent.Objects[nBtn].Class)) = ALLTRIM(UPPER("tg_opcionMenuTop")) AND this.Parent.Objects[nBtn].esModulo
							this.Parent.Objects[nBtn].backcolor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
						ENDIF
					ENDFOR
					
					this.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnMenu")
					_screen.activeform.olblRuta.caption = ""
				ENDIF
			ENDIF
		ENDIF
		
		IF this.ubicarDerecha AND ALLTRIM(UPPER(this.Parent.Class)) = ALLTRIM(UPPER("tg_modulosTop"))
			IF thisform.oTblEmpresas.buscar(oApp.IdEmpresa, .F., "CLAVE")
				IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
					FOR nBtn = 1 TO this.Parent.Objects.Count
						IF ALLTRIM(UPPER(this.Parent.Objects[nBtn].Class)) = ALLTRIM(UPPER("tg_opcionMenuTop")) AND this.Parent.Objects[nBtn].ubicarDerecha AND this.Parent.Objects[nBtn] <> this
							this.Parent.Objects[nBtn].backcolor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
						ENDIF
					ENDFOR
					
					IF this.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnMenu")
						this.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
					ELSE 
						this.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnMenu")
					ENDIF 
				ENDIF
			ENDIF
		ENDIF
		
		IF this.ubicarDerecha 
			thisform.cantContenedoresDerecha = thisform.cantContenedoresDerecha + 1
			cNuevoContenedor = "oContOpcionesDerecha" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedoresDerecha))
		ELSE
			IF this.esModulo
				oApp.eliminarContOpcionesMenu()
			ENDIF 
			thisform.cantContenedores = thisform.cantContenedores + 1
			cNuevoContenedor = "oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores))
		ENDIF 
		
		thisform.AddObject(cNuevoContenedor, "tg_modulosTOP")
		cNuevoContenedor = "thisform." + cNuevoContenedor
		WITH &cNuevoContenedor.
			.top = thisform.oContOpciones1.top
			.width = thisform.oContOpciones1.width 
			.height = thisform.oContOpciones1.height 
			
			IF this.ubicarDerecha 
				.left = SYSMETRIC(1) - .width - 10
			ELSE
				.left = thisform.oContOpciones1.left 
			ENDIF 
			
			IF !EMPTY(_screen.activeform.olblRuta.caption)
				_screen.activeform.olblRuta.caption = _screen.activeform.olblRuta.caption + " > "
			ENDIF 
			_screen.activeform.olblRuta.caption = _screen.activeform.olblRuta.caption + ALLTRIM(this.Caption)
			
			.ocultarOtrosContenedores()
			.cargarBotones(thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Name,5,LEN(this.name)))), 1], thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Name,5,LEN(this.name)))), 2], thisform.vMenuLlamarBotones[VAL(ALLTRIM(SUBSTR(this.Name,5,LEN(this.name)))), 3])
		ENDWITH
		
		thisform.oTbxBusqueda.setFocus()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LPARAMETERS lEsModulo, lUbicarDerecha
		
		this.esModulo = lEsModulo
		this.ubicarDerecha = lUbicarDerecha
		
		this.WordWrap = .T.
		
		IF thisform.oTblEmpresas.buscar(oApp.IdEmpresa, .F., "CLAVE")
			IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
				this.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
				this.ForeColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorLetraFinal")
			ELSE
				this.BackColor = RGB(229,20,0)
				this.ForeColor = RGB(255,255,255)
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF 
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE MouseEnter
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		**this.BackColor = RGB(21,100,19)
		
		**this.BackColor = this.BackColor + 40
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE MouseLeave
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		**this.BackColor = RGB(32,154,29)
		
		**this.BackColor = this.BackColor - 40
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		Height = 480, ;
		Left = 420, ;
		Name = "oTorre", ;
		Picture = ..\bmp\torre_login-01.png, ;
		Stretch = 1, ;

		Width = 530, ;
		ZOrderSet = 0
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="image" />
	
	PROCEDURE agregarfavorito
		lParameters cForm, cTipo, cTitulo, cModulo
		
		LOCAL vGrabacion
		DIMENSION vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		IF !thisform.oTblFavoritos.buscar(ALLTRIM(UPPER(oApp.CodUsuario())) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(cForm)) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(cTipo)), .F., "USUPROTIPO")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_proceso", cForm)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_tipoproceso", cTipo)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_usuario", oApp.CodUsuario())
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "opcion", cTitulo + "(" + ALLTRIM(cTipo) + "-" + cModulo + ")")
			thisform.oTblFavoritos.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.F.,.T.)
				
			FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
				IF TYPE("thisform.Objects[i]") = "O" AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Name) <> UPPER("oContModulos") AND thisform.Objects[i].esFavoritos
					thisform.Objects[i].cargarFavoritos()
				ENDIF
			ENDFOR
		ELSE
			=fMensAceptar("El formulario ya es Favorito.")
		ENDIF 
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrarfavorito
		lParameters cForm, cTipo
		
		IF thisform.oTblFavoritos.buscar(ALLTRIM(UPPER(oApp.CodUsuario())) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(cForm)) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(cTipo)), .F., "USUPROTIPO")
			thisform.oTblFavoritos.borrar()
			
			FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
				IF TYPE("thisform.Objects[i]") = "O" AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Name) <> UPPER("oContModulos") AND thisform.Objects[i].esFavoritos
					thisform.Objects[i].cargarFavoritos()
				ENDIF  
			ENDFOR 
		ELSE
			=fMensAceptar("El formulario no era Favorito.")
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE esfavorito
		LPARAMETERS cForm, cTipo
		
		RETURN thisform.oTblFavoritos.buscar(ALLTRIM(UPPER(oApp.CodUsuario())) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(cForm)) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(cTipo)), .F., "USUPROTIPO")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DODEFAULT()
		LOCAL nObjeto
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblUsuarios", 	"tg_tabla", "usuarios", 	"CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblProcesos",	"tg_tabla",	"procesos", 	"CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblTemas",		"tg_tabla",	"temas", 		"CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblEmpresas",	"tg_tabla",	"empresas", 	"CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblFavoritos", "tg_tabla", "menufavoritos","CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMainMenu", 	"tg_tabla", "mainmenu",		"CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblTerminal", 	"tg_tabla", "terminal",		"CLAVE")
		
		** Mariano 04/12/2017 **
		thisform.AddObject("oTblResoluciones", "tg_tabla", "resoluciones"	, "CLAVE")
		thisForm.AddObject("oViewNovedades", "tg_viewNovedadesSistema")
		
		if thisForm.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oApp.Usuario, .F., "Clave")
			thisForm.oViewNovedades.refrescar(thisForm.oTblUsuarios.leer("fecha_nov"), oApp.Usuario)
		endIf
		** Mariano 04/12/2017 **
		
		thisform.oTblTerminal.irPrimero()
		
		thisform.oTblTerminal.Buscar(oApp.Maquina, .F., "CLAVE")
		IF !Empty(thisform.oTblTerminal.leer("ImagenTema"))
			thisform.pathImagenes = ALLTRIM(thisform.oTblTerminal.leer("ImagenTema")) 
		else
			thisform.pathImagenes = ALLTRIM(thisform.oTblTerminal.leer("dircentral")) + "..\imagenes\"
		ENDIF
		
		thisform.nCantidadBarsAbiertas = 0
		
		IF !DIRECTORY(thisform.pathImagenes)
			=fMensAceptar("No se encontró el directorio de imagenes. No podrá utilizarse el menú correctamente. Contacte con soporte para habilitar el mismo.")
			
			FOR nObjeto = 1 TO thisform.ControlCount
				thisform.Objects[nObjeto].visible = .F.
			ENDFOR 
		ELSE 
			IF thisform.oTblEmpresas.buscar(oApp.IdEmpresa, .F., "CLAVE")
				IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
					thisform.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorFondo")
					thisform.oBtnVolver.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathbtnvolver")
					thisform.oBtnVolver.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
					thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathbtnmostrarsysmenu")
					thisform.oBtnSysMenu.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
					thisform.oBtnSalir.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathCerrar")
					thisform.oBtnSalir.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
					**thisform.oBtnPlataformaVideos.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathCerrar")
					thisform.oBtnPlataformaVideos.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
					thisform.oBtnPlataformaVideos.ForeColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorLetraFinal")
					thisform.oTorre.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathTorre")
					
					** Mariano 04/12/2017 **	
					if !thisForm.oViewNovedades.esTablaVacia() AND thisForm.oTblUsuarios.Leer("MostrarNov")
						thisForm.oViewNovedades.irUltimo()
						nRegistros = thisForm.oViewNovedades.recno()
						if thisForm.oTblResoluciones.buscar(STR(thisForm.Width,4)+STR(thisForm.Height,4), .F., "Clave")
							thisForm.oBtnNotificaciones.Caption = PADR(nRegistros,thisForm.oTblResoluciones.leer("espacios"), " ")
						else
							thisForm.oBtnNotificaciones.Caption = PADR(nRegistros,3, " ")
						endIf
						thisform.oBtnNotificaciones.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathCantNotificaciones")
						thisform.oBtnNotificaciones.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
					else
						thisForm.oViewNovedades.refrescar(ctod("  /  /    "))
						thisform.oBtnNotificaciones.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathNotificaciones")
						thisform.oBtnNotificaciones.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
					endIf
					** Mariano 04/12/2017 **
								
					_SCREEN.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorFondo")
				ELSE
					this.BackColor = RGB(255,255,255)
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF
			
			thisform.Width = SYSMETRIC(1)
			thisform.Height = SYSMETRIC(2)
		
			thisform.oBtnCambioTema.Visible = .F.
		
			thisform.cantContenedores = 1
			thisform.cantContenedoresDerecha = 0
			thisform.nIdBoton = 1
			thisform.nIdBotonBusqueda = 1
			thisform.tipoFormulario = 1
		
			thisform.oContModulos.Width = 800
			thisform.oContModulos.left = 19
			thisform.oContModulos.cargarBotones("PRINCIPAL", "Menú Principal")
			thisform.oContModulos.top = 4
			thisform.oContModulos.height = 35
			thisform.oContModulos.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
		
			thisform.oShpBandaAzul.Visible = .F.
		
		*!*		thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Top = 4
		*!*		thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Visible = .T.
		*!*		thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Width = 20
		*!*		thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Height = 30
		*!*		thisForm.ObtnSysMenu.Left = thisform.oContModulos.width+thisform.oContModulos.left
		*!*			
		*!*		thisform.oBtnSalir.Width = thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Width
		*!*		thisform.oBtnSalir.Height = thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Height
		*!*		thisform.oBtnSalir.Top = thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Top
		*!*		thisform.oBtnSalir.Visible = .T.
		*!*		thisForm.oBtnSalir.Left = thisForm.Width- thisForm.oBtnSalir.Width
			
			thisform.oContOpciones1.width = INT(SYSMETRIC(1) / 7) && 200 MATIAS S. 16/02/17
			thisform.oContOpciones1.height = SYSMETRIC(2) - 175
			thisform.oContOpciones1.top = 68
			thisform.oContOpciones1.left = 19
			thisform.oContOpciones1.visible = .T.
			thisform.oContOpciones1.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
			
			thisform.olblRuta.Left = thisform.oContOpciones1.left
			thisform.olblRuta.top = thisform.Height - thisform.olblRuta.Height - 110
			thisform.olblRuta.Caption = ""
		
			thisform.oBtnVolver.Left = thisform.oContOpciones1.left
			thisform.oBtnVolver.Top = thisform.oContModulos.Top + thisform.oContModulos.Height + 5
			thisform.oBtnVolver.Width = 30
			thisform.oBtnVolver.Height = 21

			thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Top = thisform.oBtnVolver.Top
			thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Width = thisform.oContOpciones1.width - thisform.oBtnVolver.Width  - 2
			
			thisform.oBtnPlataformaVideos.Left = thisform.Width - thisform.oBtnPlataformaVideos.Width - 10
			thisform.oBtnPlataformaVideos.Top = thisform.Height - thisform.oBtnPlataformaVideos.Height - 120
		
			IF !thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("menuOrigin")
				oApp.manejarSysMenu()
			ENDIF 
		
			thisform.manejarImagenBtnSysMenu()
			Thisform.otbxBusqueda.SetFocus()
		ENDIF 
		
		oApp.asignarMenuBase(thisform)
		
		** Mariano 04/12/2017 **
		thisform.oBtnNotificaciones.Top 	= thisform.oContModulos.Top
		thisform.oBtnNotificaciones.Left 	= thisform.oContModulos.width+thisform.oContModulos.left
		thisform.oBtnNotificaciones.Width 	= thisform.oContModulos.Height - 5 
		thisform.oBtnNotificaciones.Height 	= thisform.oContModulos.Height - 5

	PROCEDURE levantarnovedades
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE manejarimagenbtnsysmenu
		IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
			IF oApp.menuPrincipalActivo()
				thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathBtnOcultarSysMenu")
			ELSE
				thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathBtnMostrarSysMenu")
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE manejarmenuoriginal
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Resize
		DODEFAULT()
		
		thisform.oContOpciones1.Width = thisform.oTbxBusqueda.width + thisform.oTbxBusqueda.left - thisform.oBtnVolver.Left && MATIAS S. 17/02/17
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnCambioTema.Click
		local oAuxuliar
		oAuxiliar=CreateObject("tg_setearTema")
		oAuxiliar.Show()
		
		IF thisform.oTblEmpresas.buscar(oApp.IdEmpresa, .F., "CLAVE")
			IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
				thisform.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorFondo")
				thisform.oBtnVolver.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathbtnvolver")
				thisform.oBtnVolver.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
				thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathbtnmostrarsysmenu")
				thisform.oBtnSysMenu.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
				thisform.oTorre.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathTorre")
				
				**thisform.oBtnVolver.PicturePosition = 14
			ELSE
				this.BackColor = RGB(255,255,255)
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF
		
		thisform.oContModulos.cargarBotones("PRINCIPAL", "Menú Principal")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnNotificaciones.Click
		LOCAL dFechaNotificaciones,lMostrar
		
		lMostrar = .T.
		
		thisForm.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oApp.Usuario, .F., "Clave")
		thisForm.oViewNovedades.refrescar(thisForm.oTblUsuarios.leer("fecha_nov"), oApp.Usuario)
		IF thisForm.oViewNovedades.EsTablaVacia()
			
			IF fMensPregunto("No tiene nuevas notificaciones. ¿Quiere ver las notificaciones ya leídas del último mes?","N")	="S"
				
				dFechaNotificaciones = DATE() - 30
				
				thisForm.oViewNovedades.refrescar(dFechaNotificaciones, oApp.Usuario)
			Else
				lMostrar = .F.
			ENDIF
		ELSE
			dFechaNotificaciones  = thisForm.oTblUsuarios.leer("fecha_nov")
		ENDIF
		
		IF lMostrar AND !thisForm.oTblUsuarios.Leer("UsuLector")
			if type("thisForm.oFormNovedades") <> "O" OR ISNULL(thisForm.oFormNovedades)
				thisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisForm.oFormNovedades","tg_formNovedadesSistema",.F.,dFechaNotificaciones )
			ENDIF
		
			thisForm.oFormNovedades.show()
		Endif
		
		thisForm.oBtnNotificaciones.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathNotificaciones")
		thisForm.oBtnNotificaciones.Caption = ""
		thisForm.oBtnNotificaciones.Refresh()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnPlataformaVideos.Click
		oApp.AbrirPlatadormarVideo()                                                                        
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnSalir.Click
		&&oApp.Salir()                                                                                        
		
		Release oFormIF
		
		IF oApp.CleanUp()
		  RELEASE oApp
		ENDIF 
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnSysMenu.Click
		** Matias S. 28/05/18 **
		LOCAL vGrabacion
		DIMENSION vGrabacion[1,2]
		** Matias S. 28/05/18 **
		
		oApp.manejarSysMenu()
		
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oApp.CodUsuario(), .F., "CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "menuOrigin", !thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("menuOrigin"))
			thisform.oTblUsuarios.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
		ENDIF 
		
		thisform.manejarImagenBtnSysMenu()
		
		IF oApp.menuPrincipalActivo()
			thisform.oLblRuta.Top = thisform.oLblRuta.Top - 20
			thisform.oBtnPlataformaVideos.Top = thisform.oBtnPlataformaVideos.Top - 20
		ELSE
			thisform.oLblRuta.Top = thisform.oLblRuta.Top + 20
			thisform.oBtnPlataformaVideos.Top = thisform.oBtnPlataformaVideos.Top + 20
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnVolver.Click
		IF TYPE("thisform.oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores))) = "O" AND thisform.cantContenedores > 1
			thisform.RemoveObject("oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores)))
			thisform.cantContenedores = thisform.cantContenedores - 1
		
			FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
				IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].name) = UPPER("oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores)))
					thisform.Objects[i].visible = .T.
				ENDIF
			ENDFOR
		ENDIF 
		
		IF RAT(" > ",thisform.olblRuta.caption) = 0
			thisform.olblRuta.caption = ""
		ELSE
			thisform.olblRuta.caption = SUBSTR(thisform.olblRuta.caption,1,RAT(" > ",thisform.olblRuta.caption)-1)
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxBusqueda.InteractiveChange
		LOCAL cNuevoContenedor
		
		IF LEN(ALLTRIM(this.Value)) > 2
			IF TYPE("thisform.oContBusqueda") = "O"
				thisform.RemoveObject("oContBusqueda")
			ENDIF 
			
			thisform.oBtnVolver.Visible = .F.
			thisform.oLblRuta.Visible = .F.
			
			thisform.AddObject("oContBusqueda", "tg_busquedaTOP")
			cNuevoContenedor = "thisform.oContBusqueda"
			WITH &cNuevoContenedor.
				.Width = thisform.oContOpciones1.Width
				.Height = thisform.oContOpciones1.Height
				.Left = thisform.oContOpciones1.Left
				.Top = thisform.oContOpciones1.Top
				.cargarBotones(this.value)
			ENDWITH 
		ELSE
			thisform.oLblRuta.Visible = .T.
			thisform.oBtnVolver.Visible = .T.
			
			IF TYPE("thisform.oContBusqueda") = "O"
				thisform.RemoveObject("oContBusqueda")
				
				FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
					IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].parentClass) = UPPER("Container") 
						thisform.Objects[i].visible = .T.
					ENDIF  
				ENDFOR 
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF
		
		
		
		
		
		*!*	IF LEN(ALLTRIM(this.Value)) > 2
		*!*		thisform.oContBusqueda.cargarBotones(this.Value)
		*!*	ELSE
		*!*		thisform.oContBusqueda.Visible = .F.
		*!*	ENDIF
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TG_TIMERBASE.Timer
		thisform.oContRecientes.cargarRecientes()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
