	PROCEDURE agregarfavorito
		lParameters cForm, cTipo, cTitulo, cModulo
		
		LOCAL vGrabacion
		DIMENSION vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		IF !thisform.oTblFavoritos.buscar(ALLTRIM(UPPER(oApp.CodUsuario())) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(cForm)) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(cTipo)), .F., "USUPROTIPO")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_proceso", cForm)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_tipoproceso", cTipo)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_usuario", oApp.CodUsuario())
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "opcion", cTitulo + "(" + ALLTRIM(cTipo) + "-" + cModulo + ")")
			thisform.oTblFavoritos.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.F.,.T.)
				
			FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
				IF TYPE("thisform.Objects[i]") = "O" AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Name) <> UPPER("oContModulos") AND thisform.Objects[i].esFavoritos
					thisform.Objects[i].cargarFavoritos()
				ENDIF
			ENDFOR
		ELSE
			=fMensAceptar("El formulario ya es Favorito.")
		ENDIF 
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrarfavorito
		lParameters cForm, cTipo
		
		IF thisform.oTblFavoritos.buscar(ALLTRIM(UPPER(oApp.CodUsuario())) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(cForm)) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(cTipo)), .F., "USUPROTIPO")
			thisform.oTblFavoritos.borrar()
			
			FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
				IF TYPE("thisform.Objects[i]") = "O" AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Class) = UPPER("tg_modulosTOP") AND UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].Name) <> UPPER("oContModulos") AND thisform.Objects[i].esFavoritos
					thisform.Objects[i].cargarFavoritos()
				ENDIF  
			ENDFOR 
		ELSE
			=fMensAceptar("El formulario no era Favorito.")
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE esfavorito
		LPARAMETERS cForm, cTipo
		
		RETURN thisform.oTblFavoritos.buscar(ALLTRIM(UPPER(oApp.CodUsuario())) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(cForm)) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(cTipo)), .F., "USUPROTIPO")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DODEFAULT()
		LOCAL nObjeto
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblUsuarios", 	"tg_tabla", "usuarios", 	"CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblProcesos",	"tg_tabla",	"procesos", 	"CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblTemas",		"tg_tabla",	"temas", 		"CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblEmpresas",	"tg_tabla",	"empresas", 	"CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblFavoritos", "tg_tabla", "menufavoritos","CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMainMenu", 	"tg_tabla", "mainmenu",		"CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblTerminal", 	"tg_tabla", "terminal",		"CLAVE")
		
		thisform.RemoveObject("mwresize1")
		
		thisform.oTblTerminal.irPrimero()
		thisform.pathImagenes = ALLTRIM(thisform.oTblTerminal.leer("dircentral")) + "..\imagenes\"
		thisform.nCantidadBarsAbiertas = 0
		
		IF !DIRECTORY(thisform.pathImagenes)
			=fMensAceptar("No se encontró el directorio de imagenes. No podrá utilizarse el menú correctamente. Contacte con soporte para habilitar el mismo.")
			
			FOR nObjeto = 1 TO thisform.ControlCount
				thisform.Objects[nObjeto].visible = .F.
			ENDFOR 
		ELSE 
			IF thisform.oTblEmpresas.buscar(oApp.IdEmpresa, .F., "CLAVE")
				IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
					thisform.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorFondo")
					thisform.oBtnVolver.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathbtnvolver")
					thisform.oBtnVolver.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
					thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathbtnmostrarsysmenu")
					thisform.oBtnSysMenu.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
					thisform.oBtnSalir.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathCerrar")
					thisform.oBtnSalir.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
					thisform.oTorre.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathTorre")
					_SCREEN.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorFondo")
				ELSE
					this.BackColor = RGB(255,255,255)
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF
			
			thisform.Width = SYSMETRIC(1)
			thisform.Height = SYSMETRIC(2)
		
			thisform.oBtnCambioTema.Visible = .F.
		
			thisform.cantContenedores = 1
			thisform.cantContenedoresDerecha = 0
			thisform.nIdBoton = 1
			thisform.nIdBotonBusqueda = 1
			thisform.tipoFormulario = 1
		
			thisform.oContModulos.Width = 800
			thisform.oContModulos.left = 19
			thisform.oContModulos.cargarBotones("PRINCIPAL", "Menú Principal")
			thisform.oContModulos.top = 4
			thisform.oContModulos.height = 35
			thisform.oContModulos.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
		
			thisform.oShpBandaAzul.Visible = .F.
		
			thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Top = 4
			thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Left = thisform.oContModulos.width + thisform.oContModulos.left
			thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Visible = .T.
			thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Width = 20
			thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Height = 30
		
			thisform.oBtnSalir.Top = thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Top
			thisform.oBtnSalir.Left = thisform.oBtnSysMenu.width + thisform.oBtnSysMenu.left + 10 
			thisform.oBtnSalir.Visible = .T.
			thisform.oBtnSalir.Width = thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Width
			thisform.oBtnSalir.Height = thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Height 
		
			thisform.oContOpciones1.width = INT(SYSMETRIC(1) / 7) && 200 MATIAS S. 16/02/17
			thisform.oContOpciones1.height = SYSMETRIC(2) - 175
			thisform.oContOpciones1.top = 68
			thisform.oContOpciones1.left = 19
			thisform.oContOpciones1.visible = .T.
			thisform.oContOpciones1.oCmbVolver.Visible = .F.
			
			thisform.olblRuta.Left = thisform.oContOpciones1.left
			thisform.olblRuta.top = thisform.Height - thisform.olblRuta.Height - 70
			thisform.olblRuta.Caption = ""
		
			thisform.oBtnVolver.Left = thisform.oContOpciones1.left
			thisform.oBtnVolver.Top = thisform.oContModulos.Top + thisform.oContModulos.Height + 5
			thisform.oBtnVolver.Width = 30
			thisform.oBtnVolver.Height = 21
		
			thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Left = thisform.oBtnVolver.Left + thisform.oBtnVolver.Width + 2
			thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Top = thisform.oBtnVolver.Top
			thisform.oTbxBusqueda.Width = thisform.oContOpciones1.width - thisform.oBtnVolver.Width  - 2
		
			IF !thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("menuOrigin")
				oApp.manejarSysMenu()
			ENDIF 
		
			thisform.manejarImagenBtnSysMenu()
		ENDIF 
		
		oApp.asignarMenuBase(thisform)
		
		**Thisform.AddObject("mwresize1","mwresize")
		**thisform.mwresize1.Visible = .f.
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE manejarimagenbtnsysmenu
		IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
			IF oApp.menuPrincipalActivo()
				thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathBtnOcultarSysMenu")
			ELSE
				thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathBtnMostrarSysMenu")
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE manejarmenuoriginal
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Resize
		DODEFAULT()
		
		thisform.oContOpciones1.Width = thisform.oTbxBusqueda.width + thisform.oTbxBusqueda.left - thisform.oBtnVolver.Left && MATIAS S. 17/02/17
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnCambioTema.Click
		local oAuxuliar
		oAuxiliar=CreateObject("tg_setearTema")
		oAuxiliar.Show()
		
		
		IF thisform.oTblEmpresas.buscar(oApp.IdEmpresa, .F., "CLAVE")
			IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
				thisform.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorFondo")
				thisform.oBtnVolver.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathbtnvolver")
				thisform.oBtnVolver.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
				thisform.oBtnSysMenu.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathbtnmostrarsysmenu")
				thisform.oBtnSysMenu.BackColor = thisform.oTblTemas.leer("colorBtnFinal")
				thisform.oTorre.Picture = thisform.pathImagenes + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathTorre")
				
				**thisform.oBtnVolver.PicturePosition = 14
			ELSE
				this.BackColor = RGB(255,255,255)
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF
		
		thisform.oContModulos.cargarBotones("PRINCIPAL", "Menú Principal")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnSalir.Click
		oApp.Salir()                                                                                        
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnSysMenu.Click
		oApp.manejarSysMenu()
		
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oApp.CodUsuario(), .F., "CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "menuOrigin", !thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("menuOrigin"))
			thisform.oTblUsuarios.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
		ENDIF 
		
		thisform.manejarImagenBtnSysMenu()
		
		IF oApp.menuPrincipalActivo()
			thisform.oLblRuta.Top = thisform.oLblRuta.Top - 20
		ELSE
			thisform.oLblRuta.Top = thisform.oLblRuta.Top + 20
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnVolver.Click
		IF TYPE("thisform.oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores))) = "O" AND thisform.cantContenedores > 1
			thisform.RemoveObject("oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores)))
			thisform.cantContenedores = thisform.cantContenedores - 1
		
			FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
				IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].name) = UPPER("oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores)))
					thisform.Objects[i].visible = .T.
				ENDIF
			ENDFOR
		ENDIF 
		
		IF RAT(" > ",thisform.olblRuta.caption) = 0
			thisform.olblRuta.caption = ""
		ELSE
			thisform.olblRuta.caption = SUBSTR(thisform.olblRuta.caption,1,RAT(" > ",thisform.olblRuta.caption)-1)
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxBusqueda.InteractiveChange
		LOCAL cNuevoContenedor
		
		IF LEN(ALLTRIM(this.Value)) > 2
			IF TYPE("thisform.oContBusqueda") = "O"
				thisform.RemoveObject("oContBusqueda")
			ENDIF 
			
			thisform.oBtnVolver.Visible = .F.
			thisform.oLblRuta.Visible = .F.
			
			thisform.AddObject("oContBusqueda", "tg_busquedaTOP")
			cNuevoContenedor = "thisform.oContBusqueda"
			WITH &cNuevoContenedor.
				.Width = thisform.oContOpciones1.Width
				.Height = thisform.oContOpciones1.Height
				.Left = thisform.oContOpciones1.Left
				.Top = thisform.oContOpciones1.Top
				.cargarBotones(this.value)
			ENDWITH 
		ELSE
			thisform.oLblRuta.Visible = .T.
			thisform.oBtnVolver.Visible = .T.
			
			IF TYPE("thisform.oContBusqueda") = "O"
				thisform.RemoveObject("oContBusqueda")
				
				FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
					IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].parentClass) = UPPER("Container") 
						thisform.Objects[i].visible = .T.
					ENDIF  
				ENDFOR 
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF
		
		
		
		
		
		*!*	IF LEN(ALLTRIM(this.Value)) > 2
		*!*		thisform.oContBusqueda.cargarBotones(this.Value)
		*!*	ELSE
		*!*		thisform.oContBusqueda.Visible = .F.
		*!*	ENDIF
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TG_TIMERBASE.Timer
		thisform.oContRecientes.cargarRecientes()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_recientestop AS container 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="container" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="oLblMenu" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: cargarrecientes
		*m: refrescar
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		BackColor = 255,255,255
		BackStyle = 0
		BorderWidth = 0
		Height = 375
		Name = "tg_recientestop"
		Width = 650
	*</PropValue>

	ADD OBJECT 'oLblMenu' AS tg_lblmenu WITH ;
		Left = 3, ;
		Name = "oLblMenu", ;
		Top = 3
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="eiffel_prueba1.vcx" BaseClass="label" />
	
	PROCEDURE cargarrecientes
		LOCAL nCantRecientes, lbCond, nCantBotonesDelMenu, nMaximoLenCaption, nCantIdealAncho, nCantIdealLargo, lIdealEncontrado, nAnchos, nCantIdealLargoEx, nAltoExacto
		
		this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.refrescar()
		
		nAncho = 150
		nAlto = 30
		nCantIdealAncho = 1
		nLeftInicial = 2
		nTop = 30
		nLeft = 2
		nCantMaximo = 4
		nAnchos = 0
		
		nCantRecientes = 0
		this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irPrimero()
		do while !this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.EsEof() AND nCantRecientes < 6
		
			nCantRecientes = nCantRecientes + 1
			this.AddObject("oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantRecientes)),"tg_abrirForm", this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.leer("objeto"), this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.Leer("id_tipoproceso"))
			
			lbObject = "this.oCmd"+ALLTRIM(STR(nCantRecientes))
			WITH &lbObject.
				.Caption = ALLTRIM(this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.Leer("titulo"))
				.Width = nAncho
				.Height = nAlto
				.Visible = .T.
				
				.Top = nTop
				.Left= nLeft
				
				nAnchos = nAnchos + 1
				
				nTop = nTop + .Height + 2
			ENDWITH
					
			this.oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		this.Height = (nAlto + 2) * nAnchos + 32
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		****************
		** DEPRECATED **
		****************
		
		this.AddObject("oViewFormsRecientesDelUsuario", "tg_viewFormsRecientesDelUsuario")
		
		this.oLblMenu.Caption = "Recientes"
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescar
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_seteartema AS form 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="form" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="oEjemplo" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_btnaceptar1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="oCmbTemas" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_btnaceptar2" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_label1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	*<PropValue>
		BorderStyle = 2
		Caption = "Modificar tema"
		Closable = .F.
		DoCreate = .T.
		Height = 540
		Left = 6
		Name = "tg_seteartema"
		Top = 6
		Width = 820
		WindowState = 0
		WindowType = 1
	*</PropValue>

	ADD OBJECT 'oCmbTemas' AS tg_cmbtemas WITH ;
		Left = 97, ;
		Name = "oCmbTemas", ;
		Top = 7
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="eiffel_prueba1.vcx" BaseClass="combobox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'oEjemplo' AS tg_image WITH ;
		Height = 450, ;
		Left = 8, ;
		Name = "oEjemplo", ;
		Picture = ..\bmp\torre_login-01.png, ;
		Stretch = 1, ;
		Top = 46, ;
		Width = 800, ;
		ZOrderSet = 0
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="image" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_btnaceptar1' AS tg_btnaceptar WITH ;
		Left = 647, ;
		Name = "Tg_btnaceptar1", ;
		Top = 512
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="commandbutton" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_btnaceptar2' AS tg_btnaceptar WITH ;
		Caption = "\<Cancelar", ;
		Left = 731, ;
		Name = "Tg_btnaceptar2", ;
		Top = 512
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="commandbutton" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_label1' AS tg_label WITH ;
		AutoSize = .T., ;
		Caption = "Seleccionar tema:", ;
		Left = 6, ;
		Name = "Tg_label1", ;
		Top = 11
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="label" />
	
	PROCEDURE Init
		thisform.AddObject("oTblTemas","tg_tabla","temas", "CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblEmpresas","tg_tabla","empresas", "CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblTerminal", 	"tg_tabla", "terminal",		"CLAVE")
		
		IF thisform.oTblEmpresas.buscar(oApp.IdEmpresa, .F., "CLAVE")
			IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color"), .F., "CLAVE")
			
				thisform.oTblTerminal.irPrimero()
		
				IF !EMPTY(thisform.oTblTerminal.leer("ImagenTema"))
					thisform.oTblTerminal.Buscar(oApp.Maquina, .F., "CLAVE")
					thisform.oEjemplo.Picture = ALLTRIM(thisform.oTblTerminal.leer("ImagenTema")) + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathEjemplo")
				Else
					thisform.oEjemplo.Picture = ALLTRIM(thisform.oTblTerminal.leer("dircentral")) + "..\imagenes\" + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathEjemplo")
				ENDIF 		
				
				thisform.oCmbTemas.Value = thisform.oTblEmpresas.leer("id_color")
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF 
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmbTemas.InteractiveChange
		IF thisform.oTblTemas.buscar(thisform.oCmbTemas.value, .F., "CLAVE")
			thisform.oTblTerminal.irPrimero()
		
			IF !EMPTY(thisform.oTblTerminal.leer("ImagenTema"))
				thisform.oTblTerminal.Buscar(oApp.Maquina, .F., "CLAVE")
				thisform.oEjemplo.Picture = ALLTRIM(thisform.oTblTerminal.leer("ImagenTema")) + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathEjemplo")
			Else
				thisform.oEjemplo.Picture = ALLTRIM(thisform.oTblTerminal.leer("dircentral")) + "..\imagenes\" + thisform.oTblTemas.leer("pathEjemplo")
			ENDIF 
		
		ENDIF 
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		LOCAL vGrabacion
		DIMENSION vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		IF thisform.oTblEmpresas.buscar(oApp.IdEmpresa, .F., "CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_color", thisform.oCmbTemas.value)
			thisform.oTblEmpresas.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
			
			=fMensAceptar("El tema se modificó correctamente. Debe salir y volver a entrar al sistema para ver las modificaciones.")
			thisform.Release()
		ELSE
			=fMensAceptar("Ocurrió un error intentando modificar el tema.")
		ENDIF
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar2.Click
		thisform.Release()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_volvermenu AS commandbutton 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="commandbutton" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*p: cformaabrir
		*p: ctipo
		*p: ofrm
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		Caption = "Prueba"
		cformaabrir = .F.
		ctipo = .F.
		Height = 51
		MousePointer = 15
		Name = "tg_volvermenu"
		ofrm = .F.
		Picture = ..\bmp\atrasmenutop.png
		PicturePosition = 1
		SpecialEffect = 1
		Style = 0
		Width = 124
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE Click
		thisform.cantContenedores = thisform.cantContenedores - 1
		
		*!*	FOR i = 1 to thisform.Objects.count
		*!*		IF UPPER(thisform.Objects[i].name) = UPPER("oContOpciones" + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.cantContenedores)))
		*!*			thisform.Objects[i].visible = .T.
		*!*		ENDIF
		*!*	ENDFOR
		
		thisform.RemoveObject(this.Parent.Name)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE MouseEnter
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		this.BackColor = this.BackColor - 40
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE MouseLeave
		LPARAMETERS nButton, nShift, nXCoord, nYCoord
		
		this.BackColor = this.BackColor + 40
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
